text:
samir_ops: Heads up — customer X is asking why their Private deployment invoice shows a flat 'Private infra surcharge' on top of usage. They're pushing for a breakdown of what that covers (GPU licenses, on-prem support, network egress?).
anya_finance: Do we have a canonical split for private deployments? I recall we introduced a reserved-license line for Dedicated but not sure how that maps to VPC/on-prem.
samir_ops: We never broke down the on-prem line item historically. For Dedicated we show: `Reserved GPU capacity`, `Runtime license`, `Support SLA`. On-prem feels fuzzier because a lot is pass-through (third-party driver licensing, vendor support) + our private control plane fee.
leo_platform: For on-prem customers we usually bundle: 1) platform subscription (monthly), 2) optional reserved capacity charge if they buy committed GPU nodes we manage, 3) 3rd-party vendor license pass-through (if we procure). We should avoid the vague "surcharge" label.
anya_finance: Customer wants cost allocation on the invoice. Options: itemize vendor pass-through as separate lines (showing cost + markup or zero-markup), or amortize our platform license into a per-gpu/month line. Which is preferred legally?
samir_ops: Legal prefers transparency for pass-through vendors (show exact vendor charge). For our license, product suggests a separate recurring line called `Redwood Private Platform Fee`.
leo_platform: Two tricky things: a) if the customer manages hardware themselves (air-gapped), there is no vendor pass-through, only our platform+support. b) if we provision hardware in their DC (we act as reseller), then vendor invoices go through us and we need to decide resale pricing.
anya_finance: Ok. For customer X specifically — they have a VPC deployment where we manage nodes but they asked for GPU license breakouts. I'll propose: `Vendor GPU License (NVIDIA)` as a pass-through line, `Redwood Private Platform Fee`, and `Reserved GPU capacity — committed` with the amortized per-node rate.
samir_ops: That seems reasonable. One more nuance: some vendors require per-GPU seat licensing tied to serials — we should confirm whether cost is per card or per instance. Might affect rounding on invoice.
leo_platform: Also remember to include optional KMS/HSM key management fees. We had one customer dispute last quarter because KMS usage appeared as a surprise line.
anya_finance: Good call. I'll add `KMS key management` if KMS is enabled.
samir_ops: From ops side, there's also potential network egress in cross-region setups — we typically label that as `Cloud egress/Inter-region networking` and show provider rate.
anya_finance: For the billing system change: Do we need a new invoice template? Or can we reuse Dedicated template and toggle boolean flags that expand lines?
leo_platform: Reuse Dedicated template but add a flag `is_on_prem_reseller` and `is_customer_managed_hardware`. If `is_on_prem_reseller` true -> include vendor pass-through lines and a `procurement markup` optional line.
samir_ops: Quick example snippet for the invoice generator (pseudo):
```
if is_on_prem_reseller:
  add_line('Vendor GPU License (NVIDIA)', vendor_cost)
  if markup_pct > 0:
    add_line('Vendor procurement markup', vendor_cost * markup_pct)
else:
  add_line('Redwood Private Platform Fee', platform_fee)
```
anya_finance: Thanks. Two questions: 1) Do we ever absorb vendor license discounts (i.e., keep price stable for customers even if we get volume discounts)? 2) How to handle tax/VAT on pass-through lines?
leo_platform: 1) We sometimes absorb small discounts to keep pricing stable but must document that in pricing policy. 2) Taxes depend on jurisdiction; pass-through lines typically follow vendor tax treatment, but we need tax team to confirm.
samir_ops: Action items: 
- @anya_finance to draft invoice line mapping and sample invoice for Customer X (due EOD tomorrow).
- @leo_platform to confirm whether vendor GPU license is per-card or per-instance for Customer X's hardware (due today).
- @billing-bot to run a test invoice preview for Customer X with flags `is_on_prem_reseller=true`, `include_kms=true` and post results.
anya_finance: I'll draft and post the sample. If legal wants different wording we'll adjust.
billing-bot: invoice-preview: customer_id=12345 flags={"is_on_prem_reseller":true,"include_kms":true} -> preview generated (see internal link: https://billing.internal/previews/12345).
samir_ops: Thanks — once Leo confirms vendor license granularity I'll reconcile numbers and send to the customer.
leo_platform: Confirmed: vendor license is per-GPU-card for their node SKUs. Posting the SKU->license mapping to the thread.
anya_finance: Got it. Draft done, posting screenshot of mock invoice. I'll CC legal if wording needs review. :thumbsup:
samir_ops: Great. Closing loop here. If anyone sees a better tax treatment or we need to reclassify lines, ping finance.
leo_platform: Also leaving a note for docs team: update KB "Private deployment billing lines" with examples and FAQs.
anya_finance: Will do. Thanks all.
